**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Mr Moor](../persons.html#1046)
I enclose the £1 I fancied I had heard that [Miss Le Gallais](../persons.html#855) had made her start in life.

Will you tell [Selina](../persons.html#1048) that I am sending on the magazine today[^1]

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Moor\'s daughter Selina seems to have been the editor of a magazine, perhaps the Ampfield Parish Magazine.
